post_hoc_rank_diagnostics.role: localization only; neither raw rank geometry nor effective rank is a model-selection metric

interpretation.established: Coordinate-only training reduced its supervised losses and preserved cross-task output diversity, but it did not recover the corresponding successful-policy direction or effective magnitude.
interpretation.earliest_interface: After additive query-to-output shortcuts were removed, target/rank queries only changed attention locations. The resulting factors expressed insufficient rank-specific content: outputs remained more rank-concentrated than the direct adapters and own-task retrieval fell to 1/24.
interpretation.claim_boundary: This rejects the v4 content-only readout and the same 228-visit continuation. It does not reject the ECP Program, privileged q_pi, absolute single-LoRA surface, or later policy support and reward objectives, because those objectives were deliberately absent from this segment.

decision.next: Keep content/address separation, but let numeric target/rank queries multiplicatively modulate cross-attended Program content. This preserves the zero-content zero-output invariant while restoring query-conditioned content before support and reward credit are added.
